From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@northbridge-assess.com>

Subject: Evidence request: release trail, PR gating & shortlived-secret controls

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking time on the SOC 2 mapping. As part of our deeper SIG/CAIQ review for EnterpriseBank, we need a compact evidence bundle demonstrating your secure release pipeline for model-serving code paths. Specifically we're looking for:

- PR gating logs showing required reviewers and automatic checks (last 30 days)
- CI/CD runbook that describes gated releases, rollback policy, and who can approve
- Secrets handling proof: ephemeral credential rotation cadence + KMS/HSM usage notes
- Change management audit for any prod-facing infra change in the last 90 days

Can you provide the above artifacts, plus a short high-level narrative of how Redwood enforces PR-level policy (e.g., branch protections, required approvers, automated SCA/static analysis), and confirm whether any parts are handled by third-party CI providers vs your dedicated infra? Ideally we can get these by EOD Monday (US PST) so EnterpriseBank can close the few open SIG gaps.

If it's easier I can accept a Drive folder link and a short email pointing to the key files.

Appreciate it —
Alex

--
Alex Cho

Subject: Re: Evidence request: release trail, PR gating & shortlived-secret controls

Alex —

Thanks — looping in Monica (build/release) and Priyom (security ops) to assemble. Quick answers up front:
- PR gating: enforced via branch protections in GitHub with required CODEOWNERS approvals + a mandatory CI status check that runs static analysis and SCA.
- CI/CD: mix of our owned GitHub Actions runners for build/test and a dedicated, internal runner fleet in our VPC for release signing and deployment to Dedicated/Private customers.
- Secrets: short-lived tokens via our in-house ephemeral token service backed by Vault (transit + KV). Rotation cadence is 7 days for runner tokens and 30 days for service-to-service certs; HSM-backed keys used for signing.
- Change mgmt: we maintain a change request Jira workflow (SUP series) with approvals from Release Manager + Security; all production-facing changes require explicit CANARY and rollback steps.

I'll attach a minimal evidence package and a runbook excerpt; Monica will add the recent PR log export and Priyom will include the vault rotation snapshot.

Karthik

Alex / Linda —

Attached is a Vault rotation snapshot (vault-rotation-snapshot-20261101.txt) that lists rotation events for ephemeral runner tokens and the KMS/HSM usage summary (redacted key IDs). To summarize the controls:

- Ephemeral token issuance: tokens minted with TTLs of 6–12 hours for CI jobs; runner bootstrap tokens rotated every 7 days.
- Secrets access: IAM policies are tight — only runner service accounts and the deployer service can request transit unwraps; all requests are auditable via Vault audit logs.
- Third-party CI: we use GitHub Actions for non-sensitive tests; the final signing and deployment are on our private runners inside the customer's region for Dedicated/Private, so signing keys never leave our VPC/HSM.

I've also included a link to the evidence Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ReleaseEvidence — the folder has the CSVs, runbook PDF, and rotation snapshot. Let me know if you want the raw Vault audit events for a defined window; we can export them under NDA.

Thanks,
